headline: CNPC passes 13 Mt of cumulative CO2 injected as it pushes CCUS commercialisation
summary: China National Petroleum Corp says it has injected over 13 million tonnes of CO2 to date (>60% of the Chinese petroleum sector total), with H1 2026 injection of 1.37 Mt (+14.2% y/y), mostly via CO2-EOR; it plans integrated industrial CCUS clusters in the 15th Five-Year Plan.
co2crc_note: China's largest CCUS-EOR operator scaling toward Gt-class basin clusters is a competitive and technical benchmark for Australian storage ambitions.
extractor_note: 13 Mt is a cumulative injected volume (resource/progress), not additive annual capacity; capacity_mtpa left null.

headline: US BLM offers Tallgrass a right-of-way grant for Southeast Wyoming CO2 storage
summary: The US Bureau of Land Management offered Tallgrass Energy a right-of-way grant to use 480 acres of federally managed pore space in Laramie County for its Southeast Wyoming CO2 Sequestration Project; final Wyoming DEQ Class VI injection-well permits are still needed before injection.
co2crc_note: Federal pore-space access mechanics inform how public-land storage tenure can be structured; relevant to Australian offshore/onshore acreage frameworks.
extractor_note: Grant is offered pending Class VI permits; not yet operational.

headline: ICVCM approves Verra's CCS methodology under the Core Carbon Principles
summary: The Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market approved Verra's CCS methodology as meeting its Core Carbon Principles, giving CCS-based credits access to the high-integrity CCP label.
co2crc_note: High-integrity crediting of CCS improves the voluntary-market revenue case for storage projects CO2CRC and partners could develop.

headline: Revcoo brings all-electric cryogenic capture to a Belgian zinc plant in its first metals-sector deal
summary: French firm Revcoo will deploy its all-electric cryogenic CarbonCloud system at Reazn's recycled-zinc alloy plant in Kruisem, Belgium, targeting 5,000-8,000 tpa of 99.99%-purity CO2; a feasibility study and FEED come first, with full operation slated for late 2028.
co2crc_note: Solvent-free electric cryogenic capture and a new hard-to-abate sector (metals) broaden the capture-technology field CO2CRC tracks.
extractor_note: capacity_mtpa from stated up-to-8,000 tpa (0.008 Mtpa); pre-FID feasibility stage.

headline: CCS projects could draw ~EUR8.7bn from the EU's proposed Industrial Decarbonisation Bank
summary: Phase I of the EU's proposed Industrial Decarbonisation Bank could channel around EUR8.7 billion to CCS projects, per external estimates, as part of the July 2026 EU ETS revision package.
co2crc_note: Scale of EU public support for CCS shapes the global competitive landscape for capital and offtake.
extractor_note: External estimate of a proposed (not-yet-approved) programme allocation; radar/near-miss item, out of daily window.
